narrative:
Short impact summary

Artificial Intelligence for a Better Future (2021), published by Springer Nature, has been cited 71 times — enough that OpenAlex puts it in the top 10% of works in its field and year. Beyond that, it has been downloaded 25,667 times.

Full narrative

Artificial Intelligence for a Better Future by Bernd Carsten Stahl was published by Springer Nature in 2021. It is part of the SpringerBriefs in Research and Innovation Governance series. Conceptually, the work connects to Perspective (graphical), Engineering ethics, Environmental ethics, Management science and Data science.

OpenAlex records 71 citations. That places it in the top 10% of works in its field and year of publication. Citations peaked in 2024 with 29 citing works. Notable citing venues include Özgür Yayınları eBooks, International Journal of Science and Research Archive and Procedia Computer Science. Of 71 citation statements scite has classified, 3 support its claims, 64 mention it in passing, and none contradict it. The citing works include 48 journal articles, 9 book chapters and 4 preprints. They come from 34 countries, led by the United States, the United Kingdom and Nigeria.

It has been downloaded 25,667 times via OAPEN. Open Library reports a combined count of 2 reading logs and catalog editions.
